main_text.p: pro confervatione conjugij supplicabant, & erat dies proprie fe-stus matronis.
Numa etiam in lege suâ Pilumnum & Picumnum innuit:
main_text.l: Sei. Puer. Parentem. Verberit. Ast. Ole.
Plora Sit. Puer. Deiveis. Parentum. Sacer.
main_text.p: Unde liquet statim post Ἀποθέωσιν collatum istum honorem.

p.i: Lar pater, Vobis mando meum parentum rem bene ut tute-mini.

main_text.p: Porrò Picumnus, sive Mars Silvanus, præstes Larum erat; ut Pluto Manium, Jupiter Deorum, Janus Geniorum. Id docent Inscriptiones veteres. pag. LXV. 2.
main_text.head: Sylvano.

page.notes: Right-hand page number "221" is at the top right. Greek word "Ἀποθέωσιν" as printed. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The Sylvano block is set in spaced capitals and is treated as a heading.
